I told Ilse in our DM that her Quarrendon Freight Lines dock is Bay 30. I took this from her own message to me on Oct 14, and she hasn't mentioned a change since.

I couldn't get it back from gbrain. It refused to read anything because this bot's connection isn't tied to any member. Since the brain serves several people, it won't answer until whoever runs the brain server ties the connection to the right person. The command it suggests is:
`gbrain auth rescope --token trial-…e/r2 --member '<MEMBER>'`

Until that's done, anything saved in gbrain this way can't be read back, so it's not a reliable store for members' personal facts. Ilse's DM history with me is the dependable record for now.
